translations.name: Workforce Alliance of South Central Kansas
translations.description: The Workforce Centers offer free help finding a job, writing a resume, and training for a new career. You need legal permission to work in the U.S. to get help from staff. Some training programs have their own rules. Walk-ins are welcome at 2021 N. Amidon.
translations.website_description: Find local job help, training, workshops, and Workforce Center services.
